intro.text: The house steward of Kholinar Palace.

items.text: On the night of the feast celebrating the treaty with the listeners, Gereh found Navani in the palace gardens to tell her that Brightlord Rine Hatham was waiting to see Gavilar, who could not be found, and led her to him. Hours afterwards Navani found Gereh shaking and in tears, and he told her the king had been assassinated.
